messages:
Maya: Quick sync to assign owners/times for IM-2026-1123 follow-ups. Keep it short.

Ethan: I'll take provider failover testing + SLA escalation. Plan draft by Thu EOD.

Priya: I'll own model-registry hardening: token rotation + health probe + dashboard. ETA Wed.

Nora-SRE: I'll implement eviction/cold-cache alert and a circuit-breaker runbook entry. PR by Tue.

Omar-Security: I'll handle immediate key rotation and a scoped audit. Also add a mitigation flag to the card. ETA Thu AM.

ops-bot: Created IM-2026-1123/followups card: https://redwood.internal/kanban/IM-2026-1123 :spiral_calendar:

Maya: Please add your name to the actions sheet (https://docs.google.com/.../postmortem-actions) and link PRs in the repo.

Ethan: FYI provider noted maintenance windows that conflict with our failover window. I'll request a narrow maintenance exemption or schedule outside their window.

Priya: For short-term: propose increasing registry token TTL from 1h -> 4h while we ship rotation+refresh. Security sign-off?

Omar-Security: OK for 4h temp TTL if we scope tokens and rotate immediately. Will run key rotation tonight.

Nora-SRE: Alert draft:```yaml
- alert: RegistryKVEvictions
  expr: increase(kv_evictions_total[10m]) > 50
  for: 5m
```
I'll open the PR and add runbook links.

Maya: Good. Also need a recurring "external-deps" postmortem rollup (monthly) to surface patterns across incidents. Who owns the analysis?

Priya: I can take the first month to correlate registry auth failures with region latency and provider incidents. Will add dashboard queries.

Ethan: I'll coordinate with our provider rep and get a statement on historical flakiness to add to the rollup.

Maya: Timeline check: PRs and sheet updates by Fri EOD. Monthly rollup initial draft by next Wed. If blocked, call it out here.

Priya: Not blocked. Opening initial dashboard PR today and tagging #pm-followup.

Ethan: Slight blocker on failover tests until provider confirms maintenance windows. I'll update by Thu.

Maya: Thanks all. I'll collate PR links and statuses Fri and update the postmortem doc. Ping me if you need to reassign.
